results.title: Doxo to pay million dollar settlement in consumer redress to FTC
results.description: The Federal Trade Commission approved a stipulated final order that requires online bill‐payment firm Doxo and its co‐founders Steve Shivers and Roger Parks to pay US $2.1 million in consumer redress and to refrain from misrepresenting affiliations, fees and subscription terms.
